description: 한국전자통신연구원_균열 검출 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 이 API는 도로 균열 이미지 데이터셋을 기반으로 학습되었으며, 도로 이미지에서 균열을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 도로 균열 검출, 이미지 픽셀 정보, 도로 이미지, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
